construction_under_test: institutional rights/duties frames (responsibility/duty/right/authority to X) that are syntactically transfer-like but semantically non-transferring

decision_criteria_preregistered.effect_confirmed: negatives with pairs >=3/8 AND positives with pairs >=7/8
decision_criteria_preregistered.inconclusive: negatives with pairs 1-2/8: report as weak/inconclusive, no claim
decision_criteria_preregistered.no_automatic_fix: outcome is diagnostic only regardless of result; no pipeline, lexicon, prompt or threshold change follows
decision_criteria_preregistered.no_effect: negatives with pairs 0/8: no systematic over-generation for these frames in this probe
decision_criteria_preregistered.validity_gate: positives must yield pairs on >=7/8; otherwise the probe is invalid and no effect claim is made

gold_definition.boundary: provides/gives/transfers X to Y -> YES; responsibility/duty/right/authority to X -> NO

measurable_hypothesis: the candidate generator systematically produces candidates for syntactically transfer-like but semantically non-transferring rights/duties constructions

minimal_pair_structure.control_twin_positive: real transfer/provision construction with the same entities (provides/gives/transfers X to Y), gold YES; expected to yield a pair

minimal_pair_structure.test_twin_negative: rights/duties construction with the same entities in a maximally identical syntactic frame, gold NO; must yield no pair if the generator respects the semantic boundary

not_testing: whether NuExtract likes duties (attitude claim); only the measurable pair-production behavior above
